results.message: What goes in my employment portfolio?
results.text:
Your employment portfolio is a great way to show employers what you can do. According to the [Employment Portfolio Checklist](/api/documents/download?id=cmmyyb7tt0036eadkzpoj2ucf&mode=view), you should include:

*   Your resume, cover letter, and references
*   Your high school diploma or equivalency
*   Any certificates you have earned
*   Letters of reference
*   A completed master application
*   Samples of your computer skills (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
*   Examples of your writing

Would you like to look at your current portfolio to see what you already have in there?

results.message: What is the personal attendance contract?
results.text:
The Personal Attendance Contract is an agreement where you commit to a regular class schedule to meet your required weekly or monthly hours. It outlines your commitment to treat SPOKES classes like a job, including notifying your instructor and caseworker if you are going to be absent, late, or leaving early.

You can review the full document here: [SPOKES Personal Attendance Contract FY26 Fillable](/api/documents/download?id=cmmyyb9di003aeadkem94x1dz&mode=view)

results.text:
To register for a free LearningExpress Library account, follow these steps:

1. Go to [WVinfodepot.org](http://WVinfodepot.org).
2. Click on "Databases A-Z" in the menu on the left.
3. Scroll down to "LearningExpress Library" and click the link.
4. On the registration screen, fill in your details to create your account.
